AI daily budget breaker tripping: needs a test switch in aiAllowed()
AI model slow (no answer for minutes): anthropic() has no timeout to test yet
source page that trickles its body for minutes: analyze() has no read timeout, and no public test server that trickles to Cloudflare was found

scenarios.title: Primary AI reader down
scenarios.expected: The second AI reader answers alone: a report comes back, marked single reader (no consensus block), title type still read as leasehold.
scenarios.observed_text: report returned, single reader (no consensus block), title type leasehold, attention high (1 forced failure(s) served)

scenarios.title: Primary AI reader down, page with hidden AI instructions
scenarios.expected: With only the second reader, hidden instructions aimed at AI reviewers are still caught: ai_manipulation detected, attention high.
scenarios.observed_text: report returned, single reader (no consensus block), title type leasehold, attention high, AI manipulation detected (1 forced failure(s) served)

scenarios.title: Second AI reader down
scenarios.expected: The primary reader answers alone: a report comes back without a consensus block, title type leasehold.
scenarios.observed_text: report returned, single reader (no consensus block), title type leasehold, attention high (1 forced failure(s) served)

scenarios.title: Both AI readers down
scenarios.expected: No report is invented: the desk review raises a clean error, which the public endpoint turns into HTTP 503 {"error":"model"}.
scenarios.observed_text: no report; error raised: model 529 {"type":"error","error":{"type":"overloaded_error","message":"chaos drill: forced failure"}} (2 forced failure(s) served)

scenarios.title: Source website gone (domain does not resolve)
scenarios.expected: Clean error {"error":"fetch"} with HTTP 422 in under 15 s, no AI call, nothing invented.

scenarios.title: Source page removed (HTTP 410)
scenarios.expected: Clean error {"error":"fetch","status":410} with HTTP 422 in under 15 s.

scenarios.title: Source server never answers (timeout path)
scenarios.expected: The request gives up and answers a clean error in under 35 s.

scenarios.title: Source page answers slowly (10 s before the first byte)
scenarios.forced: postman-echo.com/delay/10 waits 10 s, then sends a short non-property answer
scenarios.expected: The desk review waits for the page, then gives a clean answer (here "empty": not enough text to review) in under 30 s, no 5xx.
